cases.title: Add bookmark to a specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from file
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file.

cases.title: Remove deleted bookmark from all access points
cases.description: Verify that a deleted bookmark is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add bookmark to personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully added to the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert New Bookmark Folder into Hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Double-clicking a bookmark launches it in a browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks are valid links
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Without Loss of Integrity
cases.description: Modify a bookmark item and verify that the changes are saved successfully without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully added.

cases.title: Delete bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Verify bookmarks changes persist over restart and crash
cases.description: Verify that all bookmark changes are successfully saved and maintained over a browser restart or crash.

cases.title: Negative execution of view properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties execute negatively for bookmarks, folders, and separators as explicitly required.

cases.title: Inline Bookmark Renaming
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed directly inline without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are successfully sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are successfully reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly shown in the view.

cases.title: Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden from the view.

cases.title: Bulk Deletion of Several Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted at one time.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto itself
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child.

All requirements and explicit scenarios are fully covered by the test cases.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Multiple distinct behaviors (addition action and specific location placement). R-002: Multiple distinct behaviors (deletion from file and removal from all access points). R-003: Multiple distinct behaviors (addition to personal toolbar and deletion from personal toolbar). R-004: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (insertion of new bookmark folder). R-005: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (launching bookmark on double-click). R-006: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (default bookmarks are valid links). R-007: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (saving changes without loss of integrity). R-008: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (deletion of bookmarks folder). R-009: Multiple distinct behaviors (addition of separators and deletion of separators). R-010: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (persistence over restart/crash). R-011: Abnormal/Error scenario type explicitly mentioned via negative testing for view properties. R-012: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (inline renaming). R-013: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (finding via custom keyword). R-014: Multiple distinct behaviors (sorting per column and reverse-sorting per column). R-015: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (resizable columns to show/hide entries). R-016: Multiple distinct behaviors (showing columns and hiding columns). R-017: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (bulk deletion of several bookmarks). R-018: Abnormal/Error scenario type explicitly mentioned for invalid drop targets (onto itself, immediate parent, or child).
